ai_summary: Adani Power Limited, along with its current and erstwhile directors, has settled proceedings with the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) concerning alleged violations of public shareholding and corporate governance regulations. The settlement, made without admission of guilt, involved a non-material payment of INR 3,705,000, with the company confirming no significant financial impact; however, the underlying alleged breaches indicate past regulatory compliance issues that warrant attention.
